ch_ce313bf2.title: Sun & Shadow Observation
ch_ce313bf2.description: Find an open outdoor space. Stand or sit quietly for 12 minutes simply observing how shadows move across walls, leaves, and ground.
ch_ce313bf2.spoken_intro: Step outside into the sunlight. Find a quiet bench or grass patch, and spend twelve minutes watching the shadows. No screens needed.
ch_ce313bf2.safety_notes: Stay aware of your surroundings, respect private property, and keep your attention on the physical world.

ch_b00e70b0.title: Wild Seed & Soil Nurture
ch_b00e70b0.description: Find an outdoor plant, tree, or garden bed that looks dry or neglected. Bring a cup of water or remove choking weeds to give it space to breathe.

ch_b00e70b0.safety_notes: Stay aware of your surroundings, respect private property, and keep your attention on the physical world.

ch_081fb8b0.title: Brisk Outdoor Cadence
ch_081fb8b0.description: Engage in a 15-minute high-tempo power walk or light jog outside. Focus on deep nasal breathing and full foot push-off.
ch_081fb8b0.spoken_intro: Get your heart pumping. Lace up your shoes, head out the door, and power-walk for fifteen vigorous minutes.

ch_f4ffe1a7.title: Gentle Neighborhood Walk
ch_f4ffe1a7.description: Step outside for 20 minutes without headphones or screen glancing. Notice the transition of light on the rooftops and trees as you walk.
ch_f4ffe1a7.spoken_intro: Your mission today is quiet and simple. Put your phone on silent, step out the door, and walk for twenty minutes without headphones. Look at the horizon. I will be right here when you return.

ch_4dbc71aa.title: Barefoot Grounding / Outdoor Stretch
ch_4dbc71aa.description: Take off your shoes on clean grass or a deck. Spend 8 minutes stretching your calves, spine, and shoulders under the open sky.

ch_4dbc71aa.safety_notes: Stay aware of your surroundings, respect private property, and keep your attention on the physical world.

ch_510976b7.title: The Anonymous Errand Helper
ch_510976b7.description: Do one small helpful physical deed for someone nearby—hold an awkward door, carry a grocery bag, or return a stray shopping cart—without waiting for praise.

ch_9935fb25.title: The Ripple Smile Mission
